A '''planet''' was [[Unidentified massacre (Luthen Rael)|ravaged]] by the [[Galactic Empire]]<ref name="Make It Stop" /> in around [[18 BBY]].<ref name="Date">{{SW|url=news/andor-season-2-interview-stellan-skarsgard-elizabeth-dulau|text=''Andor'''s Stellan Skarsgård and Elizabeth Dulau Break Down Luthen and Kleya}}</ref> It had settlements, cabins, buildings with basements, streets, hills, a canal, a ridge, and a pit. When the Empire assaulted the planet, Imperial [[soldier]]s cleared basements of targets, one of which had over fifty inside. As their enemies fled, Imperial [[squad]]s attacked with [[blaster]] fire and [[flamethrower]]s, strafing and laying waste to the area while massacring the citizens. During the fighting, [[Sergeant]] [[Luthen Rael|Lear]] became disillusioned with the Empire, seating himself aboard a [[starship]] and shouting "make it stop" as he heard the noise of the destruction unfolding around him. Lear soon discovered a [[Kleya Marki|young girl]] hiding in a compartment onboard. He would rescue the girl and leave both the planet and his Imperial service, taking on the name Luthen Rael and naming the girl Kleya Marki. The two would go on to become revolutionaries.<ref name="Make It Stop" />
